description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Masters Division at the 2010 World Championships, a Gardevoir, Gallade and Machamp deck with many options: Gardevoir lets it use the opponent's Supporter cards and shuts off Poké-Powers, Gallade damages the opponent's Pokémon so Gardevoir LV.X can Knock them Out, and Machamp deals with Pokémon that haven't evolved. The 2010 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa Village, Hawaii, from 13 to 15 August 2010.

Pokémon sold it as a 2010 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
